message.content:
This is a set of two carbon steel frying pans with one detachable handle, a leather pad, and a tin of maintenance paste, so it is a retail set. The steel pans give the set its essential character, which puts it in heading 7323 (table, kitchen or other household articles of iron or steel). Within that heading, the candidate subheadings are 7323.91 (cast iron, not enameled), 7323.93 (stainless steel), 7323.94 (iron or steel, enameled) and 7323.99 (other).

The pan is raw carbon steel, not stainless, not enameled and not cast iron, so it falls under 7323.99. The statistical suffixes there are 7323.99.30 (other, not coated or plated with precious metal, cooking ware), 7323.99.50 (other), 7323.99.70, and 7323.99.90. I recall 7323.99.90 as "Other: Other" but I am not certain of the suffixes.

The related ruling (N359002) covers carbon steel pans, which I believe were classified in 7323.99.9060 or 7323.99.9080. 7323.99.90 splits into 7323.99.9060, "Other: Other, Cooking ware," and 7323.99.9080, "Other." I am not sure which applies and am going with 9060.
